prose: Anthropic is spending $3.4 billion on Caterpillar natural gas generators originally ordered by supplier OnePWR, per the Financial Times, for up to 1.7 gigawatts of power. It is unusual for a company that has preferred renting compute, such as its $1.25 billion a month deal with xAI through May 2029, and it shows how acute the power shortage is.
highlights: $3.4B for Caterpillar generators, up to 1.7 GW
xAI deal: $1.25B a month through May 2029
